rooms.name: 27F Shangri-La Ballroom
rooms.note: 18.3 m x 19.9 m. Column-free space. The classroom figure is the official "Classroom" capacity, the standing figure is the "Reception" (standing) capacity, and the banquet figure is the "Banquet" (seated formal meal) capacity. Equipped with 3D projection mapping (Ballroom only), permanent projectors/screens (100 to 215 inches), an audio/video/lighting system, free broadband internet access and technical support.

ops.parking: The hotel parking lot is on B2F. The car porch is on B1F. The height limits of the parking lot are 2.1 m on B2F, 2.5 m at the entrance on the Sotobori-dori side, and 3.2 m at the entrance on the Eitai-dori side. Parking for banquets is free for up to 4 hours (free all day for weddings). General use is 500 yen per 30 minutes / 1,000 yen per hour; for restaurant use, 1 hour is free with 3,000 yen or more, 2 hours are free with 5,000 yen or more, and 4 hours are free with 8,000 yen or more. Valet parking is 2,000 yen per day (the parking fee is separate). (Parking Guide PDF dated June 22, 2025)
ops.restaurants: The hotel has 2 restaurants (Nadaman, Japanese cuisine, on the 29th floor; and Piacere, Italian cuisine), as well as The Lobby Lounge and The Boutique. Nadaman's private room is for 4 or more guests per room with a private room fee of 16,500 yen (tax included), and for dinner a course of 18,480 yen (tax included) or more per person is required (for use from September 1, 2026; a 15% service charge is added to the displayed prices).
